description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for three different models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green)—across various linguistic categories, which are labeled along the horizontal axis as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The vertical axis represents the Shapley value, ranging from 0 to 80. The data shows that the chLSTM model exhibits the highest Shapley value at the 'T' category, reaching approximately 78, significantly higher than the other models at this point. In contrast, the mBERT and XLM-R models have relatively low values across most categories, with the exception of the 'T' category, where mBERT reaches about 58 and XLM-R reaches about 54. The 'L₁' category shows moderate values for all three models, with chLSTM slightly higher than mBERT and XLM-R. The remaining categories generally show low Shapley values, with some minor variations between the models. The legend in the top right corner identifies the color coding for each model.
